scope: Theorem 5.4 (Stable whole-space evolution) of the manuscript “Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus” (preprints/Stable-Self-Similar-Blowup-for-a-Supercritical-Defocusing-Schrodinger-Equation-on-the-Torus-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 371 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 09887025fcf67354), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a bounded real-linear map π : Y → R14 such that πE = I, S(s)E = EesΛ , πS(s) = esΛ π (s ∈ R). (5.22) For some CS < ∞ and η > 0, ∥S(s)v∥Y ≤ CSe−ηs ∥v∥Y , s ≥ 0, πv = 0. (5.23) Thus Eπ is the symmetry spectral projection. Constants depend on the fixed profile, a, and k.
